Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood evaluation & SOC2 evidence intake

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the time yesterday — excited to kick off the evaluation. I wanted to start a short MAP (mutual action plan) thread so roles, artifacts, and timelines are clear from day one. Attached is a brief MAP workbook and our SOC2 evidence request template to make the intake straightforward.

Quick summary / goals:
- Goal: Proof-of-concept + security review for Redwood inference integration with SaaSCo (internal pilot)
- Target close: agreement & procurement signed by ~2026-04-01
- Minimum deliverable: SOC2 Type II report extract + selected evidence artifacts for access controls and logging

Suggested ownership (please confirm / update):
- Redwood AE / MAP owner: Marissa Cole (me) — overall timeline & commercial coordination
- Redwood GRC point: Neha Kapoor — evidence intake, clarifications on what we need
- Redwood SE: Priyom Das — technical onboarding and artifact verification
- SaaSCo technical lead: Alex Nguyen — product owner for evaluation
- SaaSCo GRC lead: Priya Shah — primary contact for SOC2 evidence and data handling questions

Proposed initial timeline (flexible — happy to adjust):
1) MAP kickoff call — 2026-03-12 (I will share a calendar invite)
2) Evidence drop (SOC2 artifacts, redacted logs, configs) — by 2026-03-17
3) Security review complete — by 2026-03-25
4) Procurement & contract review — target complete by 2026-04-01

Asks for Priya: can you confirm the primary artifact drop format (PDFs, zipped logs, SharePoint link, S3 upload?) and whether redacted logs are acceptable for the initial review. If there are internal intake steps (security portal), please point us to the preferred channel or folder.

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-SaaSCo_v1.xlsx (workbook), SOC2_Evidence_Request_Template.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to an efficient kickoff.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for pulling this together. We're aligned on the goals and appreciate the clarity in the MAP.

Quick introductions from our side: Priya Shah is our GRC lead and will be primary for evidence delivery. Also looping in Daniel Park from Legal for contract timing/escrows.

Priya, Daniel — Priya will handle the SOC2 package. We typically provide: the full Type II report (redacted as needed), a package of screenshots & config exports, and a limited set of logs exported to CSV for access reviews. We host artifacts on our SharePoint security portal: https://saasco.sharepoint.com/security/soc2.

We can hit the 3/17 evidence drop date. For the initial review we can upload a redacted bundle (PDFs + CSV) to a secure folder; if Redwood prefers an S3 presigned upload, we can arrange that as well.

Proposed near-term: 30-min kickoff on 3/12 to align on artifact formats and sequence. I’ll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Thanks,
Alex

Perfect — thanks Alex. I just booked a 30-min kickoff for 2026-03-12 10:00 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/20260312-map-kickoff). Agenda: quick intros, confirm artifact formats, agree upload channel and SLOs for review.

Neha (GRC) — can you confirm the minimum set of artifacts that will unblock our security review? Typical asks we have are:
- SOC2 Type II report (PDF)
- Evidence for access controls (role lists, admin change logs)
- Config exports/screenshots for relevant services
- Retention & deletion policy doc (if applicable)

Also to Priya: we are fine with redacted logs for initial triage — we usually request CSV exports that include timestamps and user identifiers (hashed if needed). If you prefer SharePoint upload, please share the folder path and we’ll pull from there; otherwise we can provide a presigned S3 upload.

Rishi — can you prepare the technical onboarding checklist so Priyom has a concise list of what we’ll validate during POC? I’ll share a link to the MAP workbook after this thread is finalized.

—
Marissa

- We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II PDF and a bundle of artifacts (screenshots, config exports). For logs we typically provide compressed CSV exports with user IDs hashed — fine for your initial review.
- Primary upload channel: we will share a secure SharePoint folder; link will be posted to this thread once it's provisioned. We can also provide an S3 presigned URL if you send the target bucket/address.
- Evidence ETA: we will aim to have the initial bundle uploaded by 2026-03-17. If anything blocks, we’ll notify you immediately.

For contacts: I’ll own evidence delivery (pri ya.shah@saasco.com). Daniel will review contract timing and raise any legal constraints for escrows.

Looking forward to the 3/12 call.
